description: This file provides LDAP API functions for connecting, binding, authenticating users, and retrieving LDAP user information within the TestLink project. It includes functions for LDAP connection management, user authentication, LDAP string escaping, and user attribute retrieval.
external_files: LDAP related PHP extensions (e.g., ldap_connect, ldap_bind, ldap_search, ldap_get_entries, ldap_unbind, ldap_start_tls, ldap_errno, ldap_err2str, ldap_free_result)

methods.name: ldap_connect_bind
methods.description: Establishes a connection and binds to an LDAP server using the provided configuration, handling TLS if specified.

methods.name: ldap_authenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate a user against LDAP servers by searching for the user and binding with the found DN.

methods.name: ldap_escape_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP strings to prevent injection.

methods.name: ldap_get_field_from_username
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LDAP attribute value for a given username by searching LDAP.
